name: labs/lxkang00__oscilloscope-mcp
title: Siglent SDS2000X Plus through lxkang00/oscilloscope-mcp (SCPI transport)
intro: Siglent SDS2000X Plus through lxkang00/oscilloscope-mcp (SCPI transport), adapted from lxkang00/oscilloscope-mcp. It reads `identity`, `trigger_status` and `acquisition_state`; runs `acquisition_control`, `configure_channel`, `get_channel`, `configure_timebase` and 18 more. `acquisition_control`: send one acquisition control: run, stop, autoset, force trigger, clear measurement statistics or factory reset. The driver sends the same SCPI word the pinned handler sends. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
